tools.name: list_venues
tools.description: List every bookable Angling Lines carp fishing venue in France, with its headline facts (lake size, swims, capacity, lake record, accommodation), boolean feature flags (dogs_allowed, catfish, pool_or_hot_tub, …) and canonical URLs. The feature keys match the search_venues filter names, so prefer search_venues to filter server-side. Takes no arguments. This is the full catalogue, not an availability check.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Quote one Angling Lines venue for one fixed 7-day week: give a venue name or slug, a Saturday arrival date (YYYY-MM-DD) and the party, and get the total price for the whole party for the whole week. Prices come from the live booking engine — the venue price plus the cheapest Channel crossing for the vehicles quoted — and are in GBP. Returns a structured "unavailable" result, not a price, when that week is not free for that party.

booking_option.description: Golden Carp Lake whole package explicitly chosen by the customer after seeing available list_swims options: 1 cabin & swim 1; 2 all of swims 2,3,4; 3 exclusive without cabin; 4 exclusive with cabin. Never infer a package from a single swim preference such as swim 4. Required for GCL.

accommodation_ids.description: Selected accommodation IDs returned by list_swims for this date. GCL booking_option includes the matching cabin automatically.

include_crossing.description: True when the customer wants a crossing, including cheapest crossing at a crossing-optional venue. False for venue-only. Omit to use the venue default.

swims.description: Chosen swim numbers from list_swims; omit for suitable available defaults. Requote after changing swims.

venue.description: The venue to quote, by name or slug, e.g. "Beaurepaire".

date.description: The Saturday arrival date of the 7-day week, as YYYY-MM-DD. Every stay runs Saturday to Saturday.

anglers.description: Actual number of fishing guests supplied by the customer, never a package or swim capacity. Keep 2 guests as 2 even for a package with capacity 5.

non_anglers.description: Number of non-fishing guests. Defaults to 0.

cars.description: Number of cars travelling — crossing costs are per vehicle. Ask when unknown for a crossing quote; do not silently assume 1. Pass 0 for a van-only party. Defaults to 1 for older callers.

vans.description: Number of vans travelling. Preserve the customer's count in all crossing and booking calls. Defaults to 0.

exclusive.description: Quote the venue exclusively for this party. Some party sizes force exclusive use anyway.

tools.name: venues_available_on_date
tools.description: Check which Angling Lines venues genuinely have space for a party, either on one specific Saturday or across a whole month. Stays are fixed 7-day weeks, so an arrival date must be a Saturday in "YYYY-MM-DD" form; pass "month" as "YYYY-MM" instead to scan a whole month (defaults to the current month). Returns only venues with real availability, each with its free arrival dates and remaining capacity. Use this — not list_venues — whenever the question is about what is free or bookable.

anglers.description: Number of anglers (fishers) in the party.

date.description: A single Saturday arrival date as "YYYY-MM-DD", e.g. "2026-09-05". Use this OR "month". Stays run Saturday to Saturday, so any other weekday is rejected.

month.description: A whole month to scan as "YYYY-MM", e.g. "2026-09". Use this OR "date". Defaults to the current month when neither is given.

non_anglers.description: Number of non-fishing guests travelling with the party. Defaults to 0.

tools.name: search_categories
tools.description: Browse the curated venue categories Angling Lines maintains — themed collections such as big carp lakes, family-friendly lakes, lakes with a swimming pool, or lakes close to Calais. Called with no arguments it lists every category with its description and venue count; pass a category slug to get the bookable venues in that category. These lists are hand-picked by Angling Lines, so they cannot be reproduced by filtering on venue attributes.

category.description: The category slug to open, e.g. "big-carp-lakes". Omit it to list every category.

tools.name: search_venues
tools.description: The tool for "find me a lake": search the Angling Lines catalogue by party size, features and availability, exactly the way the website search does. Every filter is optional — call it with nothing for the whole catalogue, or combine party size ("anglers", "non_anglers"), lake facts ("min_carp_lb", "min_lake_acres") and facilities ("accommodation", "all_inclusive", "meals", "pool_or_hot_tub", "tackle_hire", "catfish", "dogs_allowed", "campervans", "rowing_boats", "bait_boats", "bait_on_site"). Add a Saturday "date" (YYYY-MM-DD) to get real availability plus "alternatives" — venues that match everything but that week, each with the nearest earlier and later free Saturday — or "months" (["YYYY-MM"]) to scan whole months. Narrow to a curated theme with "category", whose slugs come from search_categories.

anglers.description: Number of anglers (fishing guests) in the party. Defaults to 1.

non_anglers.description: Number of non-fishing guests travelling with the party. Defaults to 0.

date.description: A single Saturday arrival date as "YYYY-MM-DD", e.g. "2026-09-05". Give this to get real availability plus earlier/later alternatives. Stays run Saturday to Saturday, so any other weekday is rejected.

months.description: Whole months to scan, each as "YYYY-MM", e.g. ["2026-09", "2026-10"]. Use this OR "date". Returns venues with at least one free week in those months.

category.description: Narrow to a curated search category by slug, e.g. "big-carp-lakes". Call search_categories for the slugs that exist.

min_carp_lb.description: Only lakes whose carp record is at least this many pounds, e.g. 60.

min_lake_acres.description: Only lakes of at least this many acres, e.g. 10.

accommodation.description: Only lakes with on-site accommodation, rather than bivvy fishing.

sleeps.description: Only lakes whose accommodation sleeps at least this many. Applies with "accommodation".

fish_from_accommodation.description: Only lakes where you can fish from the accommodation. Applies with "accommodation".

meals.description: Only venues where meals are available.

pool_or_hot_tub.description: Only venues with a swimming pool or a hot tub.

tackle_hire.description: Only venues where tackle can be hired.

dogs_allowed.description: Only venues that accept dogs and other pets.

campervans.description: Only venues that take campervans and motorhomes.

bait_boats.description: Only venues where bait boats are allowed.

bait_on_site.description: Only venues selling bait on site.

crossing_optional.description: Only venues bookable WITHOUT a Channel crossing — the holiday is priced venue-only and the customer arranges their own travel.

tools.name: list_crossings
tools.description: List the Channel crossing choices for one trip — venue, Saturday arrival date (YYYY-MM-DD) and party — cheapest first. Each option gives the route, operator, ferry/tunnel type, crossing time, an overnight flag and the TOTAL holiday price with that crossing, plus the outbound/inbound route ids to pass to prepare_booking when the customer picks one. The cheapest option matches the get_quote price. Crossing choice is subject to sailing availability at checkout.

booking_option.description: Golden Carp Lake whole package explicitly chosen by the customer after seeing available list_swims options: 1 cabin & swim 1; 2 all of swims 2,3,4; 3 exclusive without cabin; 4 exclusive with cabin. Never infer a package from a single swim preference such as swim 4. Required for GCL.

accommodation_ids.description: Selected accommodation IDs returned by list_swims for this date. GCL booking_option includes the matching cabin automatically.

include_crossing.description: True when the customer wants a crossing, including cheapest crossing at a crossing-optional venue. False for venue-only. Omit to use the venue default.

swims.description: Chosen swim numbers from list_swims; omit for suitable available defaults. Requote after changing swims.

venue.description: The venue being booked, by name or slug, e.g. "Beaurepaire".

date.description: The Saturday arrival date of the 7-day week, as YYYY-MM-DD.

anglers.description: Actual number of fishing guests supplied by the customer, never a package or swim capacity. Keep 2 guests as 2 even for a package with capacity 5.

non_anglers.description: Number of non-fishing guests. Defaults to 0.

cars.description: Number of cars travelling. Use the same confirmed count as get_quote; crossing costs are per vehicle. Pass 0 for a van-only party. Defaults to 1 for older callers.

vans.description: Number of vans travelling. Use the same confirmed count as get_quote. Defaults to 0.

exclusive.description: Whether the venue is being booked exclusively.

tools.name: list_swims
tools.description: Check swim and accommodation availability for a venue on a specific Saturday date and actual party. Returns free/taken swim numbers, capacities, venue-specific rules and map URL. Golden Carp Lake sells four fixed booking_options, never individual swims: if asked for one swim, explain the full package and obtain customer acceptance before passing booking_option to get_quote, list_crossings or prepare_booking. Never silently expand a single-swim request or increase the party to package capacity. At other swim venues pass chosen swims and accommodation_ids, or allow suitable free defaults. Choices can affect price, so quote the final selection before confirming.

venue.description: The venue, by name or slug, e.g. "Fullys Lake".

date.description: The Saturday arrival date of the 7-day week, as YYYY-MM-DD.

anglers.description: Actual number of anglers, not package or swim capacity. Pass it so the tool can check which choices fit the party.

non_anglers.description: Number of non-fishing guests. Defaults to 0.

exclusive.description: Whether the customer wants the venue exclusively.

tools.name: prepare_booking
tools.description: Prepare a confirmed trip, including selected swims, accommodation, Golden Carp Lake booking_option and crossing, for the Angling Lines review page. Returns a live total and signed prefill link; creates nothing until the customer opens it. Call after the customer confirms the venue, Saturday date, party and choices. Missing or unavailable choices return a reason to resolve IN CHAT with list_swims/list_crossings; GCL can be booked through chat. Nothing is held or booked until checkout is completed.

booking_option.description: Golden Carp Lake whole package explicitly chosen by the customer after seeing available list_swims options: 1 cabin & swim 1; 2 all of swims 2,3,4; 3 exclusive without cabin; 4 exclusive with cabin. Never infer a package from a single swim preference such as swim 4. Required for GCL.

accommodation_ids.description: Selected accommodation IDs returned by list_swims for this date. GCL booking_option includes the matching cabin automatically.

include_crossing.description: True when the customer wants a crossing, including cheapest crossing at a crossing-optional venue. False for venue-only. Omit to use the venue default.

venue.description: The venue to book, by name or slug, e.g. "Beaurepaire".

date.description: The Saturday arrival date of the 7-day week, as YYYY-MM-DD. Every stay runs Saturday to Saturday.

anglers.description: Actual number of fishing guests supplied by the customer, never a package or swim capacity. Keep 2 guests as 2 even for a package with capacity 5.

non_anglers.description: Number of non-fishing guests. Defaults to 0.

cars.description: Number of cars travelling. Pass the customer's confirmed count from get_quote/list_crossings unchanged, including 0 for a van-only party. Defaults to 1 for older callers.

vans.description: Number of vans travelling. Pass the customer's confirmed count from get_quote/list_crossings unchanged. Defaults to 0.

exclusive.description: Book the venue exclusively for this party. Some party sizes force exclusive use anyway.

outbound_route_id.description: Outbound crossing route id from list_crossings. Omit (with inbound_route_id) to book the cheapest crossing.

inbound_route_id.description: Inbound crossing route id from list_crossings. Must be given together with outbound_route_id.

dog_info.description: Dog count and breed(s) supplied by the customer, e.g. "2 dogs: Labrador and Spaniel". Ask for missing count/breeds; do not invent them. Only for dog-friendly venues. Saved on the booking and review/edit pages; dog crossing fees are added on the review page, not included in this quote.

swims.description: Swim NUMBERS the customer chose (from list_swims), e.g. [1, 4]. Omit to auto-pick good free swims — the customer can change them on the review page. Ignored at venues without designated swims.
